scope: Fresh exhaustive contract and test audit of the Phase 0-4 inventory boundary, generators, reports, receipts, and production Phase-4 validator. Browser UX, mechanics, capabilities, responsive strategy, asset suitability, semantic roles, product disposition, and Phase-4 artifact authorship are outside this review.
summary: Phase 0-3 admission is green and deterministic at the reviewed head, and all 25 existing production-validator counterexamples are non-vacuous, but Phase 4 remains blocked by critical fail-open coordinated-input paths plus a validator-to-frozen-receipt schema mismatch; no live acceptance is claimed.

blocking_findings.title: The production validator trusts the untrusted bundle to define the required roles and resource ceilings
blocking_findings.detail: The exact five frozen roles and their numeric ceilings are not constants or independently loaded freeze bytes. The validator merely checks receipts against bundle.required_roles and bundle.frozen_resource_ceilings. A coordinated mutation that removes discovery-auditor from both lists returned {ok: true}; a coordinated ceiling increase to 999999 with matching usage also returned {ok: true}. The existing tests mutate only one side, so both bypasses are uncovered.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Bind the exact Phase-0 freeze and ownership bytes through a trusted committed manifest, enforce the exact five-role set and exact per-role ceiling maps, and add paired coordinated-mutation counterexamples.

blocking_findings.title: Numeric stop-loss breaches are ignored by the production acceptance boundary
blocking_findings.detail: The fixture supplies stop_loss_observations for every receipt, but validate_phase4_inventory_acceptance never reads them. Setting unsupported_factual_claims to 1 returned {ok: true}, despite the frozen stop-loss threshold of one unsupported claim requiring an immediate stop. No counterexample exercises nonzero numeric stop-loss observations.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Validate the exact stop-loss key set, require non-boolean integers, enforce zero unsupported claims, denominator mismatches, and unresolved Critical/High/Medium findings, enforce the failed-cycle limit, and add one reason-coded mutation per stop-loss field.

blocking_findings.title: Phase base, source baseline, predecessor gate, and quarantine authority are self-supplied rather than freeze-bound
blocking_findings.detail: The validator compares review and candidate fields to values from the same untrusted bundle. It does not independently require source baseline 23bb5ad5, predecessor gate d9f5c477..., the frozen quarantined prefix, or a reachable reviewed phase base. A newly committed coordinated bundle can therefore redefine the trust anchor and still satisfy its internal equalities.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Resolve the committed Phase-0 freeze through the trusted Git adapter, compare exact hashes and revisions to it, require artifact commits to descend from the admitted phase base, and add coordinated trust-anchor mutation tests.

blocking_findings.title: The production locator walker does not validate the live artifact locator schema
blocking_findings.detail: Production validation recognizes only flat locator objects containing revision/path/line_start/line_end/cited_range_sha256. The live contracts and Phase 0-3 artifacts use revision/path/blob_sha256 plus nested range.start_line/range.end_line/range.sha256. Those live locators are skipped by _walk rather than resolved, so the production boundary does not deliver the locator/hash/reachability promise made by the strategy.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Validate the actual frozen locator schema, including blob SHA-256, nested inclusive-range SHA-256, current-versus-ancestor reachability, allowed roots, and quarantine exclusion; reject unrecognized locator-shaped objects.

blocking_findings.title: The validator receipt API is incompatible with the frozen receipts it is supposed to accept
blocking_findings.detail: The frozen contract requires spawn_id, parent_ancestry_ids, actual_context_manifest_sha256, start/end event IDs, final response hash, output_sha256, budget hash, and commit. The production validator instead requires event_id/session_id/parent_session_id/agent/context_sha256 and treats output_sha256 as a path-to-hash mapping. The current provider-attested receipt uses output_sha256 as an aggregate string and output_hashes as the mapping. Thus existing evidence cannot enter the production gate without an undocumented schema rewrite, while several frozen provenance fields are never enforced.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Define and version one adapter contract from apk-role-receipt.v1 to trusted provider events, validate every frozen required provenance field and output hash, and add a control built from the committed receipt schema rather than a synthetic divergent schema.

blocking_findings.title: Plan and strategy command evidence is stale after the remediation commits
blocking_findings.detail: The live admission command now runs 37 tests, not the documented 32. The current deterministic Phase-3 hash is 88384806..., not cd72b34a..., and the current surface count is 102, not 118. The plan still says the production validator is absent and attributes 25 Phase-4 failures to a fail-open sentinel; at this head the 25 validator counterexamples pass and only ten live tests fail for the missing independent review.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Refresh plan and strategy evidence in an owner-authorized non-review commit after the blocking validator defects are fixed; do not change Phase-4 task completion or claim acceptance.
